This screen shows the behavior of the control with index on a top screen.

If a control changes and the referenced row does not exist, then the correspondig row is created otherwise it is updated.
If the index type is numeric, then every row, that does not exist before the given numeric index, is created as well.
Contact Overview (The fields above as inline repeat)

This screen show the same as the "Basic" screen with the difference that the rows also include initial values.

If a row that is used by a control with index has some initial values, then these rows will be created for every semantic and numeric index.
